claim: For every beta>0, s>=0 and theta in [0,2pi], the stopped terminal-zero probability is H(s,theta)=1-(theta+s)/(2pi)+(s/(2pi))E[exp(-(beta/4)tau)]; at theta=0 it equals the bulk gap probability.
remaining_gap: No closed nonlinear differential identity for this hitting transform has been proved.
checks: Bounded stopped SDE, uniformly L2-bounded martingale, finite quadratic variation, bounded convergence.

claim: At zero drift the terminal-zero profile is H(0,theta)=1-theta/(2pi); interior starting points never hit either endpoint at finite time.
remaining_gap: This zero-drift case does not solve the positive-gap Painleve derivation.
checks: Exact bounded-martingale expectation and Lamperti SDE with bounded drift.

remaining_gap: Applying classical boundary derivatives to the physical probability requires regularity not assumed here.

remaining_gap: Extra source-side branch data and physical selection are needed; this is not a counterexample to Virag Question 9.

remaining_gap: This determinant calculation is an external consistency check, not a generator-to-Painleve proof.

claim: 64-node Nystrom determinants are consistent with the quartic Sine_2 gap coefficient and differ from the exponential branch.
remaining_gap: Floating-point numerical consistency only; no certified error bound and no generator-to-Painleve derivation.

claim: For every beta>0 and s>=0, 0<=G_beta(s)-1+s/(2pi)<=((s/(2pi))^(p+1))/(p+1), p=min(2,(1+sqrt(1+2beta))/2).
remaining_gap: This is a weak small-gap remainder bound, not the sharp coefficient or a Painleve derivation.

claim: The carousel SDE implies a vanishing Peano quadratic gap remainder for every beta>0, excluding the exponential sigma-PV branch directly from probabilistic data.
remaining_gap: No classical second derivative is inferred solely from the asymptotic bound; physical sigma-PV remains unproved.
checks: p>1 in Section 13 and Taylor expansion of the exponential.

claim: For nonzero a, formal sigma-PV solutions with Sigma=-ar+O(r^2) have exactly two sectors: b=0 gives the linear series, and b=-a^2 gives a uniquely recursively determined formal nonlinear series. Thus there is at most one analytic PV gap germ with the physical slope and zero quadratic gap coefficient.
remaining_gap: Convergence/existence of an analytic nonlinear germ and physical carousel selection are not proved.
